rows.observed: The combined command timed out after returning only the untracked-file status listing.
rows.recovery: Disable login startup, split status and pattern inspection into bounded commands, and keep each query on known owner paths.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use non-login shell startup and separate status, file inventory, and targeted content searches so each bounded command has one purpose.

rows.observed: A repeated literal wildcard path was rejected by the Windows path layer before ripgrep searched the files.
rows.recovery: Pass concrete directories to ripgrep and constrain filenames with -g filters.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use rg -g for wildcard selection on Windows rather than wildcard path arguments.

rows.observed: The filter syntax was valid but the speculative vocabulary produced zero source rows.
rows.recovery: Use the exact test identifiers already declared by the successor selection instead of a speculative semantic pattern.
rows.recurrence_guard: When a test-selection artifact already names exclusions, search those exact public test identifiers before inventing semantic synonyms.

rows.observed: All twenty packages validated, but only nineteen smoke uses passed; cross-manifest returned false because its negative-zero mutation remained accepted.
rows.recovery: Reject negative zero explicitly before canonical-byte comparison, then require the valid fixed point and every mutation to produce the intended acceptance state.
rows.recurrence_guard: Do not infer RFC 8785 numeric normalization from the host JSON serializer; test negative zero and other forbidden numeric forms explicitly.

rows.observed: Runner one returned false because its x1 count lookup used a nonexistent field; the remaining nine runners were not invoked.
rows.recovery: Bind the external-negative reconciler to the frozen x1 ledger's new_x1_operational field and separately verify the retained-register arithmetic.
rows.recurrence_guard: Inspect the immutable source schema before binding count assertions; do not infer field names from a successor summary.

rows.observed: Forty-six entries matched; the x1 privacy and structural review companion hashes differed at equal byte lengths, and the aggregate stopped at runner four.
rows.recovery: Verify every immutable x1 Git blob, quarantine only the two known post-manifest review companions, and deny exact fixed-point credit to the x1 manifest while requiring exact parity for v646-v3 evidence and final manifests.
rows.recurrence_guard: Treat review or manifest companions written after a hash capture as quarantined drift, never as exact parity; require successor manifests to hash exact staged Git-index blobs after the path set stabilizes.
